key_insight: The paper presents a fault-tolerant digital quantum simulation framework for the quantum β-FPUT lattice that models nonlinear lattice dynamics directly in displacement space and enables mode-resolved transport analysis.
engineering_relevance: It provides a concrete resource-estimation blueprint for implementing quantum transport simulations of anharmonic low-dimensional materials on future fault-tolerant quantum computers.
method: First-quantized discretization of lattice displacements instead of truncated phonon occupation encoding.
Trotterized circuit blocks for real-time evolution of the β-FPUT Hamiltonian.
Hermitian quadrature decomposition to measure Fourier-mode displacement correlators with shallow circuits.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports qubit counts, gate complexity, circuit depth, and measurement resource estimates as functions of system size and resolution, but does not present benchmark simulation data.
watch_item: The approach is designed for fault-tolerant hardware, so near-term usefulness is limited by high qubit, depth, and error-correction requirements.
paper_title: Digital Quantum Simulation of the quantum $β$-FPUT Lattice: Formulation and Resource Estimation
